summary: Test whether individual zebrafish larvae can be re-identified across two imaging sessions 24 hours apart (6 dpf vs 7 dpf) by correlating the upper triangles of their functional connectivity matrices, building a symmetric larva×larva FC-similarity matrix, and scoring how often each larva's best match is itself.
